node.statement: Fix n, put R_n=I_n tensor R, P_n=I_n tensor P, Q_n=I_n tensor Q, and let X lie in M_n tensor S^A_{P,Q}. Apply lem-compcb-amplified-almost-containment with (P_1,P,Q_1,Q)=(P,R,Q,R): the required errors are ||PR-P||,||QR-Q||<=t, so for 2t<=e_ac, Z:=Co^A_{R_n}(X) satisfies ||Z-X||<=2*C_ac*t||X||. Lem-compcb-amplified-compression identifies Z with (I_n tensor Co_R)X in M_n tensor A_R, while node 1.1 gives uniform bounds for P_n,Q_n,P^R_n,Q^R_n,Z relative to ||X||.
